title_en: Why isn't the price on screen my fill price?
title_zh: 屏幕上的价格，为什么不是我的成交价？
goal_en: Understand the order book, the bid-ask spread, market depth, fees and slippage.
goal_zh: 理解订单簿、买卖价差、成交深度、手续费与滑点。

shots.visual_en: Sam stares at a big ticker number, places an order, then finds the average fill price is different.
shots.visual_zh: 小白盯着大号行情数字，下单后发现成交均价不同。

lines.en: It was this price a second ago. Why is my bill different?
lines.zh: 刚才明明是这个价，怎么我的账单变了？

shots.visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S2 · E13' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第2季 · 第13集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。
onscreen_text_en: Why isn't the price on screen my fill price?
onscreen_text_zh: 屏幕上的价格，为什么不是我的成交价？

shots.visual_en: The last price becomes a small historical receipt; beside it, buy and sell orders queue at different price levels.
shots.visual_zh: 最新成交价是一张历史小票；旁边买单和卖单排成不同价位的队列。

lines.en: The last price on screen is a record of the most recent trade. It's not an offer for unlimited size. How much people want to buy and sell right now is in the order book.
lines.zh: 屏幕上的最新价，是最近一笔成交的记录，不是给你无限数量的报价。现在有人愿意买多少、卖多少，要看买卖盘。

shots.visual_en: Best ask 50,000 has only 0.001 BTC; next level 50,100 also has 0.001. The order fills in two pieces.
shots.visual_zh: 最优卖价50,000只剩0.001 BTC，下一档50,100也有0.001；订单分成两份成交。

lines.en: Say you buy 0.002 bitcoin. The first level only has half. The other half fills at a higher price. Together, the average is 50,050, not 50,000.
lines.zh: 假设你买零点零零二枚，第一档只有一半，另一半只能在更高价位成交。两笔合起来，平均是五万零五十，而不是五万。

onscreen_text_en: Teaching assumption · not a live price or real platform rate
onscreen_text_zh: 教学假设 · 非实时行情，非平台真实费率

shots.visual_en: The bill unfolds: total 100.10; the fee is listed on its own line. Spread and slippage are not charged twice.
shots.visual_zh: 账单展开：成交总额100.10；再列手续费，不把价差和滑点重复扣一次。

lines.en: Slippage is the gap between the price you expected and the price you got. It isn't always against you. The trading fee is a separate cost. Don't lump them together under a 'free' slogan.
lines.zh: 滑点是预期价和实际成交价的差异，不一定都是坏方向。交易费则是另一项成本；不要把它们混在一个“免费”口号里。

shots.visual_en: A shallow pool and a deep pool show order depth; a big order dropped into the shallow pool moves the price scale more.
shots.visual_zh: 浅水池与深水池表现订单深度；大订单进入浅池，价格刻度移动更明显。

lines.en: Bigger orders, thinner depth or fast markets make it more likely the result drifts from what you expected. Check size and depth before you order, and the real average price after.
lines.zh: 订单更大、可成交深度更少或行情变化更快时，成交结果更可能偏离预期。下单前看金额和深度，成交后看实际均价。

shots.visual_en: Question card: 'Can the last price guarantee a big order fills entirely at that price?'
shots.visual_zh: 题目：页面最新价能保证大额订单全部按它成交吗？

lines.en: You only know your fill when you see the bill. Don't just watch the biggest number.
lines.zh: 看到账单才算清楚成交，不只盯着最大的那个数字。

onscreen_text_zh: 最新价 = 保证成交？ 不能

Disclosure line sits on the card itself, at least 70% of subtitle size. No reward amount, no percentage, no date. Nexubo beside the card, thumbs-up, antenna green. For restricted locales swap to the restricted_variant (official-site link only).

exercise.task_en: Match 0.002 BTC against two levels of virtual sell orders and work out the weighted average price.
exercise.task_zh: 在两档虚拟卖单中撮合0.002 BTC，计算加权平均价。
exercise.answer_en: Total 100.10, average 50,050. This is the trade amount before the teaching fee. If a 0.1% fee in USDT is also charged: fee 0.1001, total 100.2001 (don't round before calculating).
exercise.answer_zh: 总额100.10，均价50,050；这是成交金额，尚未另扣教学手续费。若另收0.1%报价资产手续费：费用0.1001，总支出100.2001（不能先四舍五入再计算）。
